text: It's frustrating but that's why this community is so valuable because it helps set expectations - I really recommend to dive into the details and try to learn as much as possible from all the experiences shared, then you won't again find yourself in a situation like this hopefully. For reference, we had submitted the docs some time October, got an appointment for January and the entry approval was issued in April - I suggest you book your flights to meet abroad every 6 weeks or so until then :)
